builds.name: Filthy Acts At A Resonable Price
builds.desc: This build mainly focuses on Luke using his brave sword to do as much damage as possible, without taking any damage, at a resonable price. Windsweep will protect follow-up attacks, Brave Sword will allow him to double with Windsweep, and Death Blow will grant him more damage while attacking. Hp +5 seal can be used to make use of Panic Ploy, or Phantom Spd 3 to make Windsweep more viable.

builds.name: Luke the Tank
builds.desc:
Luke has good Defense, HP and Attack. This build focuses on upping his defense and attack on enemy phase as high as possible, so that he can take on near any physical opponent that is not a lance user and come out of it relatively unscathed. The A slot is picked so that he can be used as a shield of sorts which combined with his 2 assist options lets him rush in and move someone to safety then tank the next foe and defeat them. Ignis is chosen since he'll nearly always be doubled, which with slaying edge allows it to be activated in nearly every fight if QR remains active. Bonfire is an alternative that is more reliable when facing armoured foes and gets some kills with less risk taken to Luke as the enemy may not get to their 2nd attack but this is at the cost of some power, which you use will depend on preference.
in a cavalry emblem his use is to allow ranged units to make very aggressive plays then provide backup against physical units that could otherwise damage them. Or he can be used to bait and draw out physical threats that could cause problems for the rest of the team.
Outside of cavalry emblem he will play similarly, but with more focus on using his panic ploy to greatly weaken opponents so that either he or others can clear them up with ease, as he'll have no need to run hone cavalry without others to buff.
